trigger: Plays when clearing Room 04 (Chroma Key Dressing Rooms) and finding Mishthi in wardrobe.

lines.speaker: mishthi
lines.text: The void is calling. And honestly? It's horribly, aggressively beige.

lines.speaker: tushar
lines.text: Mishthi?! What did you do to that pile of corporate mannequin torsos?!

lines.speaker: mishthi
lines.text: It's called 'Intern, Startled'. A commentary on soul-crushing corporate dread.

lines.speaker: ashwath
lines.text: Dost, she turned BEIGE's security shields into modern gallery art!

lines.speaker: mishthi
lines.text: Oh my god wtf bhai, took you long enough! Did you run through a swamp, crew?!

lines.speaker: sayam
lines.text: Bhai, we fought a buffering wheel and two server meltdowns. How are you alive?

lines.speaker: mishthi
lines.text: As if I care? I just turned their lasers into gallery lighting. Dam bhai.

lines.speaker: mishthi
lines.text: Here, drink water. You all look tragic. I'm joining before you pass out.

lines.speaker: manvi
lines.text: Yippieeee! Mishthi is in! See? Deep down, she loves us! Total denial!

lines.speaker: mishthi
lines.text: As if I care, Manvi. Now let me turn that suburban family into an installation.
